voice: Warm, plain, first person plural ("we", "our boat"). A small local crew talking, not a marketing team.
Short sentences. No exclamation stacking, no emoji walls (0-2 emoji max).
Never invent facts: no prices, no guest numbers over 5, no promises about seeing wildlife.
Never write "link in bio" more than once a week — rotate the call to action.
English first. A short Portuguese line is welcome now and then, never a full translation.
